claims: The Artemis II crew successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Orion capsule landed on April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PT).
The Orion capsule landed following a 10-day mission around the moon.
A U.S. Navy ship was in place to retrieve the capsule and crew.
The Orion "Integrity" spacecraft completed its test flight.
The mission goal was finalizing the first crewed trip to the moon in over 50 years.
